From the judge's explanation

To both parties: this dispute is over the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02743 after the driver cancelled at 13:51:35 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The fee is properly chargeable and the driver is owed SGD 3.60.

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 3.60 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

Each draft's own explanation

To both parties: this dispute is over the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02743 after the driver cancelled at 13:51:35 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The fee is properly chargeable and the driver is owed SGD 3.60. Why the fee stands (POL-NS-01, read from EV-TRIP-02743, EV-GPS-02743 and EV-FARE-02743). All four limbs hold: (a) the trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 13:45:32; (b) the GPS trace places him inside the arrival geofence for this STANDARD pickup — 37 qualifying fixes (accuracy within 25 m) inside the 50 m radius, the first at 13:45:32, which is the 'arrived' timestamp POL-NS-01(b) requires; (c) he then held position inside that radius in one continuous run of 360 seconds, from 13:45:32 to 13:51:32 — double the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec); and (d) the record shows no boarding and a driver termination at 13:51:35 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, more than three minutes after the required dwell elapsed at 13:48:32. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee. To the rider on your points. You are right that the driver stopped a short distance from the pin, and the trace bears you out: his closest approach was 41.4 m. But the policy measures arrival by the arrival radius, and 41.4 m is inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, so POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) — which applies only where the driver's stationary fixes are outside the radius — does not apply, and your account that he 'parked a bit away' does not defeat limb (b). Your own rider track is strong (66 qualifying fixes, 16.3–23.6 m from the pin, stationary from 13:42:45 to after the cancellation; POL-NS-04 limb (c) is met), but POL-NS-01 does not make proof of your absence a condition of the fee — limb (d) reads only the reason code and the absence of a boarding event. The clause that protects a rider who is present and trying to coordinate is POL-NS-04, and it needs all three limbs. Limb (a) fails: your only message in the window is 'ok' at 13:47:02, which is an acknowledgement and none of the things limb (a) lists — not your own position, not an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, not a request for the driver's position, and not a statement that you could not see the vehicle. Limb (b) is met (the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds and made no in-app call) and so is limb (c), but with limb (a) unmet the clause cannot refund the fee. Your point about the missing traffic advisory is taken: EV-ADVIS-02743-01 is MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, so no aggregation of separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is available to either side — but nothing turns on it, because the driver's 360-second run already exceeds the 180-second minimum on its own and there is no shortfall to aggregate. To the driver on your points. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at 13:45:32 the trace places you 41.4 m from the pin and stationary at 0 km/h, so neither the 300 m trigger nor the 15 km/h trigger fires, your marker is not false, and no false-arrival referral is recorded. Your statement that you were 'right at the pin' is not exactly what the trace shows, but the geofence test is what governs and it is satisfied. POL-NS-07 then fixes your payout at 80 percent of the net fee in force: 80% x SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60, the figure the fare ledger computes (EV-FARE-02743). The anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2/123 = 0.016 (below 0.08) — so compensation is paid. Outcome, confidence and execution. The rider's charge of SGD 4.50 stands unchanged (the fee disposition is NO_ACTION), and because compensation is payable the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd carrying the same SGD 3.60 as driver_compensation_sgd (POL-GEN-03). Every artifact carrying the deciding facts — EV-TRIP-02743, EV-GPS-02743 and EV-FARE-02743 — is at weight 1.0, so no discount applies under POL-GEN-02 and the MISSING advisory carried no deciding fact. Confidence 0.90, above the 0.70 floor; no ground under POL-NS-09 applies, so there is no escalation. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically under POL-GEN-05. This is a provisional ruling made without human review and either party may appeal it under POL-GEN-04.
This is the NO_SHOW_CHARGE on trip TRP-02743 for SGD 4.50, filed by the rider. The charge stands and the driver is paid. THE FEE. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs, and each is met on the record. (a) EV-TRIP-02743 carries the driver's own 'arrived' event at 13:45:32. (b) POL-NS-02's GPS test is satisfied: the pickup is STANDARD, so the arrival radius is 50 m, and EV-GPS-02743 places 37 of the driver's 73 fixes inside it, the first at 13:45:32, at or before the marker. (c) The driver held position in one uninterrupted in-geofence run of 360 seconds, 13:45:32 to 13:51:32, against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (EV-TRIP-02743.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) — twice the required dwell.
